formal_statement: theorem OAI.SnakyCertificate.MilestoneChecks.block19_group01_correct : (rowAt 597 = data_597 ∧ Good (rowAt 597) ∧ EntryGood 597) ∧ (rowAt 598 = data_598 ∧ Good (rowAt 598) ∧ EntryGood 598) ∧ (rowAt 599 = data_599 ∧ Good (rowAt 599) ∧ EntryGood 599) ∧ (rowAt 600 = data_600 ∧ Good (rowAt 600) ∧ EntryGood 600) ∧ True := by sorry
natural_language_statement: The original certificate rows 597 through 600 have their exact required sets, envelopes and heights and the specified subset/origin/height invariants. Nonbase entries have correct indices, nonempty term lists and backward references.
explanation: Use the proved chunk lookup and exact earlier child rows, then check the three fields separately with decide +kernel. Each row and entry predicate is also checked by the kernel. This group has at most eight rows to fit the platform compiler budget. The defining equation of the well-founded rowAt function is explicitly used once for each row. No local Lean process is started on the user's computer.
